children: IOI's solar project JV could provide a modest but recurring earnings contribution from FY2029, potentially adding 1.6%-1.9% to PATMI, says Maybank IB analyst Ong Chee Ting in a note. IOI's 25% stake in the 500MWac project, alongside land lease income and financing returns, could generate 27 million ringgit-32 million ringgit in annual income over 21 years, he says. The project will supply renewable energy to DayOne data centers in Malaysia. Ong expects IOI to pursue further renewable energy partnerships to build its portfolio. Maybank maintains a hold rating on IOI and keeps its target price at 4.67 ringgit. Shares are unchanged at 4.45 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
